# Read global information

## Enhancers

```{r enhancers}
Enhancer <- read.table("MethyLasso_Angelique_v2/WT_Master_Enhancer_Peakome_v6_annotated_TargetGene.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
Enhancer <- Enhancer %>% filter(D2_class != "othr")
Enhancer <- Enhancer %>% filter(gene_symbol != "")

gr_Enhancer <- GRanges(
  seqnames = Enhancer$chr,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = Enhancer$start, end = Enhancer$end),
  Enhancer_type = Enhancer$D2_class,
  Gene = Enhancer$gene_symbol)
```


# Functions

## ATAC ∩ Histone

```{r fn-overlap-atac-mark2}
get_overlap_atac_mark2 <- function(ATAC, mark2, mark2_name) {
  logfc_col <- paste0("LogFC_", mark2_name)
  
  gr_ATAC <- GRanges(
    seqnames = ATAC$seqnames,
    ranges   = IRanges(start = ATAC$start, end = ATAC$end),
    LogFC_ATAC = ATAC$LogFC_ATAC,
    direction = ATAC$direction)
  
  gr_mark2 <- GRanges(
    seqnames = mark2$seqname,
    ranges   = IRanges(start = mark2$start, end = mark2$end))
  mcols(gr_mark2) <- setNames(data.frame(mark2[[logfc_col]], mark2$direction),
                              c(logfc_col, "direction"))
  
  hits          <- findOverlaps(gr_ATAC, gr_mark2)
  
  overlaps      <- pintersect(gr_ATAC[queryHits(hits)], gr_mark2[subjectHits(hits)])
  overlap_width <- width(overlaps)
  frac_ATAC     <- overlap_width / width(gr_ATAC)[queryHits(hits)]
  frac_mark2    <- overlap_width / width(gr_mark2)[subjectHits(hits)]
  
  df_ATAC <- as.data.frame(gr_ATAC)[queryHits(hits), ] %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, ".ATAC"), .cols = c(seqnames, start, end, width, strand, direction))
  
  df_mark2 <- as.data.frame(gr_mark2)[subjectHits(hits), ] %>%
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, ".", mark2_name), .cols = c(seqnames, start, end, width, strand, direction))
  
  frac_mark2_col <- paste0("frac_", mark2_name)
  result <- cbind(df_ATAC,
                  df_mark2,
                  setNames(data.frame(overlap_width, frac_ATAC, frac_mark2),
                           c("overlap_width", "frac_ATAC", frac_mark2_col)))
  
  seqnames_mark2_col <- paste0("seqnames.", mark2_name)
  start_mark2_col    <- paste0("start.", mark2_name)
  end_mark2_col      <- paste0("end.", mark2_name)
  
  result <- result %>%
    group_by(seqnames.ATAC, start.ATAC, end.ATAC) %>%
    filter(frac_ATAC == max(frac_ATAC)) %>% ## Keep highest coverage of ATAC peak
    ungroup()
  
  direction_mark2_col <- paste0("direction.", mark2_name)
  result <- result %>% mutate(direction.both = case_when(
    .data[[direction_mark2_col]] != "none" & direction.ATAC != "none" ~ "Both",
    .data[[direction_mark2_col]] != "none" & direction.ATAC == "none" ~ mark2_name,
    .data[[direction_mark2_col]] == "none" & direction.ATAC != "none" ~ "ATAC",
    TRUE                                                                  ~ "None"),
    direction.both = factor(direction.both, levels = c("ATAC", mark2_name, "Both", "None")))
  
  result
}
```

## ATAC&Histone ∩ Enhancer

```{r fn-overlap-mark2-enhancer}
get_overlap_mark2_enhancer <- function(overlap_result, mark2_name) {
  seqnames_mark2_col <- paste0("seqnames.", mark2_name)
  start_mark2_col    <- paste0("start.", mark2_name)
  end_mark2_col      <- paste0("end.", mark2_name)
  
  gr.ATAC <- GRanges(seqnames = overlap_result$seqnames.ATAC,
                     ranges   = IRanges(start = overlap_result$start.ATAC, end = overlap_result$end.ATAC))
  mcols(gr.ATAC) <- overlap_result
  
  ## This function uses the coordinates of the mark2 peak as anchor
  gr.ATAC.mark2 <- GRanges(seqnames = overlap_result[[seqnames_mark2_col]],
                           ranges   = IRanges(start = overlap_result[[start_mark2_col]], end = overlap_result[[end_mark2_col]]))
  
  hits <- findOverlaps(gr.ATAC, gr_Enhancer)
  
  overlaps_enhancer      <- pintersect(gr.ATAC[queryHits(hits)], gr_Enhancer[subjectHits(hits)])
  overlap_width_enhancer <- width(overlaps_enhancer)
  frac_enhancer          <- overlap_width_enhancer/width(gr_Enhancer)[subjectHits(hits)]
  
  ## Ensure the enhancer overlaps with the mark2 peak
  overlaps_mark2_enhancer      <- pintersect(gr.ATAC.mark2[queryHits(hits)], gr_Enhancer[subjectHits(hits)])
  overlap_width_mark2_enhancer <- width(overlaps_mark2_enhancer)
  frac_mark2_enhancer          <- overlap_width_mark2_enhancer/width(gr_Enhancer)[subjectHits(hits)]
  
  result <- cbind(
    as.data.frame(gr.ATAC)[queryHits(hits),],
    as.data.frame(gr_Enhancer)[subjectHits(hits),] %>%
      dplyr::select(seqnames.Enh = seqnames, start.Enh = start, end.Enh = end, Enhancer_type, Gene),
    overlap_width_enhancer = overlap_width_enhancer,
    frac_enhancer = frac_enhancer,
    overlap_width_mark2_enhancer = overlap_width_mark2_enhancer,
    frac_mark2_enhancer = frac_mark2_enhancer)
  
  result <- result %>%
    filter(overlap_width_mark2_enhancer > 0) %>%
    group_by(seqnames, start, end) %>% ## gr_ATAC
    filter(frac_enhancer == max(frac_enhancer)) %>% ## Keep the enhancer with the maximum overlap
    filter(frac_mark2_enhancer == max(frac_mark2_enhancer)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  result
}
```

## Print number of dots per quadrant

```{r fn-quadrants}
quadrants <- function(data, x.axis, y.axis) {
  result <- data %>%
    filter({{ x.axis }} != 0, {{ y.axis }} != 0) %>%
    mutate(result = case_when(
      {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut gauche",
      {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas gauche",
      {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut droite",
      {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas droite"),
      result = factor(result, levels = c("haut gauche", "bas gauche", "haut droite", "bas droite"))) %>%
    count(result) %>%
    mutate(proportion = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))
  
  result
}
```

## Count up-/down-regulated genes per quadrant

```{r fn-quadrants-rna}
quadrants_RNA <- function(data, x.axis, y.axis, direction) {
  Gene_quad <- data %>%
    filter({{ x.axis }} != 0, {{ y.axis }} != 0) %>%
    #filter({{ direction }} %in% c("UP", "DOWN")) %>%   ## keep DE genes only (drop "NS")
    mutate(
      result = case_when(
        {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut gauche",
        {{ x.axis }} < 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas gauche",
        {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} > 0 ~ "haut droite",
        {{ x.axis }} > 0 & {{ y.axis }} < 0 ~ "bas droite"),
      result = factor(result, levels = c("haut gauche", "bas gauche", "haut droite", "bas droite")),
      {{ direction }} := factor({{ direction }}, levels = c("NS", "UP", "DOWN"))) %>%
    select(Gene, {{ direction }}, result) %>% distinct() %>% ## Remove enhancers/promoters with the same quadrant and target gene
    count(result, {{ direction }}, .drop = FALSE) %>%   ## number of NS / UP / DOWN genes per quadrant
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = {{ direction }}, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)   ## one row per quadrant, columns NS / UP / DOWN
  
  Gene_quad
}
```

# WT_K4M vs WT_H3

## Read tables of histone marks

### MATAC

```{r wt-k4m-h3-matac}
df_MATAC_all <- read.table("MATAC_analysis/DiffBind_result/scatterplot_logFCH3K27me3-MATAC/diff_peaks_D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_MATAC.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = '\t')
## Mark DE
df_MATAC_all <- dplyr::rename(df_MATAC_all, LogFC_ATAC = Fold)
df_MATAC_all <- df_MATAC_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_ATAC > 1  ~ "up",
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_ATAC < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_MATAC_all$direction)
```

### H3K4me1

```{r wt-k4m-h3-h3k4me1}
df_H3K4me1_all <- read.table("MATAC_analysis/DiffBind_result/scatterplot_H3K27me3_H3K4me1/D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_WT_H3_H3K4me1.bed", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
df_H3K4me1_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K4me1_all, seqname = Chr, start = Start, end = End, LogFC_H3K4me1 = Fold)
## Check contrast (most should lose H3K4me1)
sum(df_H3K4me1_all$LogFC_H3K4me1 > 0)
sum(df_H3K4me1_all$LogFC_H3K4me1 < 0)
## Mark DE
df_H3K4me1_all <- df_H3K4me1_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me1 > 1  ~ "up",
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me1 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K4me1_all$direction)
```


### H3K27me3

```{r wt-k4m-h3-h3k27me3}
df_H3K27me3_all <- read.table("Marlet/Results/H3K27me3/D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_WT_K4M_H3K27me3_spikeIn.txt", header = TRUE, sep = '\t')
## Mark DE
df_H3K27me3_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K27me3_all, LogFC_H3K27me3 = log2FoldChange)
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 > 1  ~ "up",
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K27me3_all$direction)
## Extract coordinates
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(
  seqname = str_extract(coord, "^[^:]+"),
  start = as.integer(str_extract(coord, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
  end = as.integer(str_extract(coord,"(?<=-)[\\d]+$")))
```

Order of comparisons:

- ATAC + H3K4me1 + enhancers

- ATAC + H3K27me3 + enhancers

\

## Combine ATAC with H3K4me1, H3K4me3, or H3K27me3

```{r wt-k4m-h3-combine-histone}
result_ATAC_K4me1 <- get_overlap_atac_mark2(ATAC = df_MATAC_all,
                                            mark2 = df_H3K4me1_all,
                                            mark2_name = "H3K4me1")
result_ATAC_K27me3 <- get_overlap_atac_mark2(ATAC = df_MATAC_all,
                                             mark2 = df_H3K27me3_all,
                                             mark2_name = "H3K27me3")

```

## Combine ATAC&Histone with Enhancer

```{r wt-k4m-h3-combine-EP}
## Enhancer
result_ATAC_K4me1_Enh <- get_overlap_mark2_enhancer(overlap_result = result_ATAC_K4me1, mark2_name = "H3K4me1")
result_ATAC_K27me3_Enh <- get_overlap_mark2_enhancer(overlap_result = result_ATAC_K27me3, mark2_name = "H3K27me3")

rm(result_ATAC_K4me1, result_ATAC_K27me3)
```

## Import limma results and merge

```{r wt-k4m-h3-rna}
df_RNA <- read.table("RNAseq_2i_to_EpiLC/RNAseq_data_Angelique/H3K4M_RNAseq_RPKM_without_dup_WT.H3K4M.D2_vs_WT.H3.D2.txt", header = TRUE)
## Clean table (remove condition tags)
colnames(df_RNA) <- str_remove(colnames(df_RNA), "_[[:alnum:].]+_vs_[[:alnum:].]+$")
df_RNA <- df_RNA %>% dplyr::rename(LogFC_RNA = logFC, direction.RNA = thresh_adjp005_fc1)
## Clean DE tags
df_RNA$direction.RNA <- str_remove(df_RNA$direction.RNA, "_[[:alnum:].]+_vs_[[:alnum:].]+$")
df_RNA$direction.RNA <- gsub(pattern = "NaN", replacement = "NS", x = df_RNA$direction.RNA)
## Add RNAseq information; drop non-quantified genes

## -- Enhancers
result_ATAC_K4me1_Enh <- result_ATAC_K4me1_Enh %>%
  left_join(df_RNA, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(LogFC_RNA))

result_ATAC_K27me3_Enh <- result_ATAC_K27me3_Enh %>%
  left_join(df_RNA, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(LogFC_RNA))
```

# TKO_H3 vs WT_H3

## Read tables of histone marks

### MATAC

```{r tko-h3-wt-h3-matac}
df_MATAC_all <- read.table("MATAC_analysis/DiffBind_result/scatterplot_logFCH3K27me3-MATAC/diff_peaks_D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_MATAC.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = '\t')
df_MATAC_all <- dplyr::rename(df_MATAC_all, LogFC_ATAC = Fold)
## Source file is WT_vs_TKO; flip sign so the ATAC axis reads TKO_vs_WT (matches section title and RNA)
df_MATAC_all$LogFC_ATAC <- -df_MATAC_all$LogFC_ATAC
## Mark DE
df_MATAC_all <- df_MATAC_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_ATAC > 1  ~ "up",
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_ATAC < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_MATAC_all$direction)
```

### H3K4me1

```{r tko-h3-wt-h3-h3k4me1}
df_H3K4me1_all <- read.table("MATAC_analysis/DiffBind_result/scatterplot_H3K27me3_H3K4me1/D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_H3K4me1.bed", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
df_H3K4me1_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K4me1_all, seqname = Chr, start = Start, end = End, LogFC_H3K4me1 = Fold)
## Contrast is already TKO_vs_WT (Conc_D2_TKO_H3 listed first) -> no flip needed
sum(df_H3K4me1_all$LogFC_H3K4me1 > 0)
sum(df_H3K4me1_all$LogFC_H3K4me1 < 0)
## Mark DE
df_H3K4me1_all <- df_H3K4me1_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me1 > 1  ~ "up",
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K4me1 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K4me1_all$direction)
```



### H3K27me3

```{r tko-h3-wt-h3-h3k27me3}
df_H3K27me3_all <- read.table("Marlet/Results/H3K27me3/D2_WT_H3_vs_D2_TKO_H3_H3K27me3_spikeIn.txt", header = TRUE, sep = '\t')
## Mark DE
df_H3K27me3_all <- dplyr::rename(df_H3K27me3_all, LogFC_H3K27me3 = log2FoldChange)
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 > 1  ~ "up",
  padj < 0.05 & LogFC_H3K27me3 < -1 ~ "down",
  TRUE                            ~ "none"))
table(df_H3K27me3_all$direction)
## Extract coordinates
df_H3K27me3_all <- df_H3K27me3_all %>% mutate(
  seqname = str_extract(coord, "^[^:]+"),
  start = as.integer(str_extract(coord, "(?<=:)\\d+")),
  end = as.integer(str_extract(coord,"(?<=-)[\\d]+$")))
```

\

## Combine ATAC with H3K4me1 or H3K27me3

```{r tko-h3-wt-h3-combine-histone}
result_ATAC_K4me1 <- get_overlap_atac_mark2(ATAC = df_MATAC_all,
                                            mark2 = df_H3K4me1_all,
                                            mark2_name = "H3K4me1")
result_ATAC_K27me3 <- get_overlap_atac_mark2(ATAC = df_MATAC_all,
                                             mark2 = df_H3K27me3_all,
                                             mark2_name = "H3K27me3")
```

## Combine ATAC&Histone with Enhancer/Promoter

```{r tko-h3-wt-h3-combine-EP}
## Enhancer
result_ATAC_K4me1_Enh <- get_overlap_mark2_enhancer(overlap_result = result_ATAC_K4me1, mark2_name = "H3K4me1")
result_ATAC_K27me3_Enh <- get_overlap_mark2_enhancer(overlap_result = result_ATAC_K27me3, mark2_name = "H3K27me3")


rm(result_ATAC_K4me1, result_ATAC_K27me3)
```

## Import limma results and merge

```{r tko-h3-wt-h3-rna}
df_RNA <- read.table("RNAseq_2i_to_EpiLC/RNAseq_data_Angelique/H3K4M_RNAseq_RPKM_without_dup_TKO.H3.D2_vs_WT.H3.D2.txt", header = TRUE)
## Clean table (remove condition tags)
colnames(df_RNA) <- str_remove(colnames(df_RNA), "_[[:alnum:].]+_vs_[[:alnum:].]+$")
df_RNA <- df_RNA %>% dplyr::rename(LogFC_RNA = logFC, direction.RNA = thresh_adjp005_fc1)
## Clean DE tags
df_RNA$direction.RNA <- str_remove(df_RNA$direction.RNA, "_[[:alnum:].]+_vs_[[:alnum:].]+$")
df_RNA$direction.RNA <- gsub(pattern = "NaN", replacement = "NS", x = df_RNA$direction.RNA)
## Add RNAseq information; drop non-quantified genes

## -- Enhancers
result_ATAC_K4me1_Enh <- result_ATAC_K4me1_Enh %>%
  left_join(df_RNA, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(LogFC_RNA))

result_ATAC_K27me3_Enh <- result_ATAC_K27me3_Enh %>%
  left_join(df_RNA, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(LogFC_RNA))
```

```{r tko-k4m-wt-k4m-matac}
## NB: despite the .csv extension this file is tab-separated (annotated DiffBind output).
## quote = "" is required: gene-name/annotation columns contain apostrophes that would
## otherwise be read as quote characters and produce ragged rows.
df_MATAC_all <- read.table("MATAC_analysis/DiffBind_result/scatterplot_logFCH3K27me3-MATAC/D2_WT_K4M_vs_D2_TKO_K4M_MATAC.csv", header = TRUE, sep = '\t', quote = "", fill = TRUE)
df_MATAC_all <- dplyr::rename(df_MATAC_all, LogFC_ATAC = Fold)
## Source file is WT_vs_TKO; flip sign so the ATAC axis reads TKO_vs_WT (matches section title and RNA)
df_MATAC_all$LogFC_ATAC <- -df_MATAC_all$LogFC_ATAC
## Mark DE
df_MATAC_all <- df_MATAC_all %>% mutate(direction = case_when(
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_ATAC > 1  ~ "up",
  FDR < 0.05 & LogFC_ATAC < -1 ~ "down",

table(df_MATAC_all$direction)
```
